title: Shared pieces every Tide contract uses
description: Ids, times, actors, stages, states and the definition-of-done checklist. Referenced as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>; never validated on its own.

woId.description: A work order id: WO- then upper-case letters, digits and dashes (WO-312, WO-0207, WO-UPG-L1-3).

yardAlias.description: The old Yard job id a work order was imported from (J312).

decisionId.description: A decision (one card for Jordan): D- then a number.

time.description: A UTC or offset time, RFC 3339 (2030-01-07T09:00:00Z).

sha.description: A git commit id, 7 to 40 lower-case hex characters.

prRef.description: A pull request as <repo short name>#<number> (tide#21).

branch.description: A git branch name: no spaces, no '..', not starting with '-' or '/'.

stream.description: A build stream name, upper case (CITY, ART, UPG-L1). At most 4 are open at once (build-way 3.3).

planRef.description: The one plan that owns the work: plans/<file>.md, optionally #<anchor>.

actor.description: Who wrote an event: jordan (only Jordan's own taps), engine, yard, github, import, or crew:<id>.

stage.description: Where a work order is on its way to closed (build-way 2.1 and 3.1).

state.description: How a work order is doing (build-way 3.1). shipped always needs proof on main.

owner.description: Who has the next move: a crew, Jordan (a card waits on him), or nobody (a lost or finished row).

check.description: One definition-of-done line: yes (done), no (missing), n/a (does not apply).

dod.description: The definition-of-done checklist (build-way 3.5), as the docs station and REPORT.md see it.

decisionKind.description: What a card asks Jordan (build-way 3.2 and 4.2).

text.description: Plain words for a person, one line or a short paragraph.

apiError.description: Every Board API error answer: ok false, a code a program can act on, and plain words for the phone.

relPath.description: A path relative to a known root (the repo or the private notes folder). Never a drive letter or a user folder.
